nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Hierarchical Bayesian regression used for normative modeling with transfer learning across scanners/sites.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we used the Hierarchical Bayesian regression (HBR) approach for normative modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness (CT) modeled to derive deviation scores.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Normative models for cortical thickness estimated on public MRI datasets ( n = 42 983) were applied to TOP data to obtain deviation scores for each region and timepoint.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age as covariate; sex and scanner id as batch effects in the normative model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: using HBR with age as a covariate, and sex and scanner id as batch effects, to predict CT.
